color.note: Three themes. Light is the page default for the website (sage-50 ground, white cards). Forest is the deep green section theme (hero overlay, werkwijze, footer) and the CMS dark mode. Sand is the warm earth band for social proof and the quote section. Set data-theme on a section or on <html>; palette tokens never change per theme.

tokens.usage: Palette. Lightest green tint: selected option tiles, success tint, hover wash on Light.

tokens.name: forest-100
tokens.usage: Palette. Icon chips behind service icons, badge fills on Light.

tokens.name: forest-200
tokens.usage: Palette. Decorative fills and illustrations only.

tokens.name: forest-500

radius.note: Friendly, soft corners like a well-kept border edge. Buttons are pills; photos and panels round more the bigger they get.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The inset hero card and the CTA band.

tokens.name: radius-full

layout.note: Mobile first: 4 columns on phones, 8 on tablets, 12 on desktop.
